scope: Keep command search selection stable during live result changes, contain long names and respect accessibility and reduced motion.

regression.unit_result: Six failed and twelve passed across eighteen tests. Reproductions covered chat/agent reordering, removal fallback, status-only scroll restarts, smooth scrolling despite reduced motion and missing accessible status descriptions.

native_baseline.command_display: bash -c 'export PATH=/home/dom/.nvm/versions/node/v22.18.0/bin:$PATH DISPLAY=:0 STATESET_DESKTOP_TEST_PORT=3000 CI=true; node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test e2e/computer-chat.spec.ts --project=electron --grep "native command palette" --workers=1 --retries=0'

regression.native_result: Both native theme cases failed when a live saved-chat reorder changed the selected identity. Before that assertion failed, each recorded 119 pixels of list overflow and 136 pixels of row overflow with a 113-character title within the supported 120-character name limit.

contrast_regression.result: First candidate passed types, lint, 21 units and both builds. Both native themes retained identity with zero overflow; the light case passed, while dark mode exposed insufficient palette section and keyboard-hint contrast (3.17–3.71 versus required 4.5). Increased muted text contrast and verified again.

implementation: Store the selected command identity and derive its current row for highlighting and keyboard navigation. Retain it through reordering; choose the first available result after removal or a new search.
Update keyboard-handler references alongside the committed layout so Enter uses the current list and selected row.
Scroll when selection, ordering or query changes; avoid restarting scroll for status-only refreshes. Use instant scrolling for reduced motion.

Increase muted palette text and keyboard-hint contrast. Contain titles in two wrapping lines, retain full names for tooltips and assistive technology, and associate each option with its status description.

verification.checks: Root/E2E types, lint, Electron/renderer builds, command/scoping units and both native theme flows with zero retries or accessibility violations.
verification.native_method: Owned Electron profiles, a 1000×760 native window and reduced-motion emulation. Controlled saved-chat updates use the public store and actual native persistence. Tests exercise live reordering, current route selection, long-title geometry, full accessible status descriptions and delegated scrollIntoView calls. No backend workflow was executed.

source_guard.qualification: Manual hashes sealed after lint/format preparation and compared after checks; not an immutable queue snapshot.
